}}'''Shein Chunla''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]] who was elected [[Amyrlin Seat]] from [[578 NE|578]] to {{Ne|601}}. She was the successor to [[Alvera Ramosanya]] and predecessor to [[Gerra Kishar]]. {{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

== History ==
Before being raised Amyrlin Seat she had been the [[Captain-General (Green Ajah)|Captain-General]] of the Green Ajah.

She was the youngest Amyrlin since [[Deane Aryman]], raised seven centuries earlier.<ref>[[The Wheel of Time Companion]], Shein Chunla</ref>

She was the Amyrlin Seat during the [[Third War of Garen's Wall]]. It is widely believed by historians that she completely mishandled the situation, and caused the war. It is also believed she died in the [[White Tower]] of natural causes.

However in the secret histories held in the [[Thirteenth Depository]] of the [[Tower Library]], it has been recorded that Shein Chunla was controlled by the [[Hall of the Tower]] during this time.

Shein had attempted to rule the Tower with an iron hand, a plan that initially worked, but the Hall took control of her by punishing her with Mortifications of both Flesh and Spirit as reply to everything she said and did, heavily mishandling the situation. The Hall and the [[Ajah Heads]] had catfights over authority, and each faction of the Hall also had its own motives and causes, pulling the Tower in different directions. Eventually the sisters themselves rose up and pulled Shein and the Hall down in one of the six mutinies in Tower history. Shein was smothered to death fifty years later while in exile, after a plot to restore her to the Amyrlin Seat was discovered, and the entire story hidden away in the Thirteenth Depository.

Centuries later [[Egwene al'Vere]] states that she doesn't want to be a failure like Shein.{{Ref/book|10|30}}

Also during her reign, two prominent women were born: [[Reanne Corly]] of the [[Knitting Circle]] of the [[Kin]] in {{Ne|588}}{{Ref/book|7|23}} and two years before her the former ''[[damane]]'' [[Alivia]] in {{Ne|586}}.

The nation of [[Almoth]] collapsed during her reign. {{Ref/book|2|7}}
